_about: Public-domain George Davis Herron (1862-1925), Congregational minister and Social Gospel lecturer at Grinnell, for the Word Hoard: his religious books only: The Larger Christ, A Plea for the Gospel, The Call of the Cross, The New Redemption, The Christian Society, The Christian State, Social Meanings of Religious Experiences, and Between Caesar and Jesus (1891-1899). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 90 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

herron-larger-christ: The larger Christ (Chicago, F. H. Revell Co, 1891)
herron-plea-gospel: A plea for the Gospel (New York ; Boson : Thomas Y. Crowell, 1892)
herron-call-cross: The call of the cross; four college sermons (New York, Fleming H. Revell company, 1892)
herron-new-redemption: The new redemption. A call to the church to reconstruct society according to the gospel of Christ (New York, T.Y. Crowell, 1893)
herron-christian-society: The Christian society (Chicago ; New York : Fleming H. Revell, 1894)
herron-christian-state: The Christian state; a political vision of Christ (New York T.Y. Crowell New York Johnson Reprint Corp, 1895)
herron-social-meanings: Social meanings of religious experiences (New York : T.Y. Crowell, c189)
herron-caesar-jesus: Between Caesar and Jesus (New York : T. Y. Crowell, [c18)

_excluded.herron-political: his political books (American Imperialism, Woodrow Wilson and the World's Peace, The Menace of Peace, Germanism and the American Crusade, The Greater War, The Revival of Italy)
